articles.title: GEFS on OpenBSD continues to improve
articles.summary: Some userspace tools have been done (you can now mkfs on openbsd!), but snapshot control hasn’t. I’m thinking we have a userspace ‘gefs’ program that lets you handle this, trying to keep the interface similar to the 9front ctl file.

articles.title: More upgrades for the Epic Games Launcher Preview including a collapsible friends list
articles.summary: Epic Games controlling rolling out fixes and features to the new Epic Games Launcher Preview , and now you can actually collapse the friends list.

articles.title: Anthropic cracks down on game cloning in Claude Code after wave of AI-built knockoffs
articles.summary: Anthropic is blocking its coding assistant Claude Code from recreating existing video games. The article Anthropic cracks down on game cloning in Claude Code after wave of AI-built knockoffs appeared first on The Decoder .

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.317
articles.summary: Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost , for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group.

articles.title: RetroTINK 6x / 4K CRT Curvature & Bezels
articles.summary: Mike Chi has released some firmware updates that add CRT curvature, bezel options and the ability to emulate composite video with all 15KHz sources; The screenshot above is an HDR example of all those options at once.

articles.title: What’s new in Android Nov. 2026 Google System Updates: Android photo backup with Quick Share for Windows
articles.summary: The monthly “ Google System Release Notes ” primarily detail what’s new in Play services, Play Store, and Play system update across Android phones/tablets, Wear OS, Google/Android TV, Auto, and PC.

articles.title: 9to5Mac Daily: November 2, 2026 – What’s next for the Mac and iPad
articles.summary: Listen to a recap of the top stories of the day from 9to5Mac . 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple’s Podcasts app , Stitcher , TuneIn , Google Play , or through our dedicated RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.

articles.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
articles.summary: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.

articles.title: Claymation slapstick comedy brawler Knuckle Creek is out now and looks awesome
articles.summary: With a banging release trailer, Knuckle Creek is one you absolutely have to check out if you love the idea of a slapstick comedy brawler made with clay.

articles.title: llm 0.37
articles.summary: Release: llm 0.37 There's a lot of stuff in this new release of my LLM CLI tool and Python library, representing around two months of accumulated features and fixes.

articles.title: AAWireless expands beyond Android Auto adapters with new cooled Qi2 car charger
articles.summary: AAWireless is known for helping you convert a wired Android Auto connection into a wireless one, but the company is now launching a new product – an active-cooled Qi2 car charger.

articles.title: John Ternus addresses iPhone Duo supply constraints, display issue
articles.summary: Today Apple reported record Q4 earnings , which beat Wall Street expectations overall. And in an interview with Reuters , CEO John Ternus addressed current iPhone Duo supply constraints and also referenced units that have been returned for display issues.

articles.title: 3dSen emulator that transforms NES games into 3D voxel dioramas v2.0 brings huge changes
articles.summary: 3dSen is just magic. An emulator that turns retro NES games into 3D voxel dioramas across flat PC gaming and VR has a huge new release out with 2.0.

articles.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
articles.summary: Why does design matter so much to a company focused on AI training? Karanam says the startup has developed an interface that makes post-training more accessible to its nontechnical customers.

articles.title: iOS 27.2’s clever new Messages feature can be tailored to your needs
articles.summary: Using these new suggestions, with a quick tap you can turn the message into an action. And they’re so small and unobtrusive in the UI that they don’t clutter up the app at all.

articles.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered launches December 3 with pre-orders up
articles.summary: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered from Atari / Nightdive is now set for release on December 3rd, with pricing and pre-orders now live. Nightdive generally do a good job on their remasters, so I will be very surprised if this doesn't sell well.

articles.title: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
articles.summary: For a tech expert, these October 2026 updates represent significant advancements in model capabilities, development tools, and hardware infrastructure. Key takeaways include the release of Gemini 4 Argon for complex coding and financial workflows, and the announcement of Gemini 4 Carbon , a model specialized in long-horizon engineering and cybersecurity defense.

articles.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
articles.summary: Israeli startup 42AI says it is developing a “behavioral world model” that can do just that, and it has just come out of stealth with $62.5 million in seed funding.

articles.title: pull_request_target blocked by default December 2
articles.summary: Starting December 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories, unless an applicable Actions event policy explicitly allows them.

articles.title: Google will let Android & iOS apps directly integrate Quick Share next year
articles.summary: At Android Dev Summit 2026, Google announced a Quick Share SDK that will let Android and iOS apps directly integrate the peer-to-peer file sharing capability.

articles.title: Upcoming: New age rating content descriptors in App Store Connect
articles.summary: Starting November 16, 2026, App Store Connect will include new content descriptors to help ensure your app’s age ratings accurately reflect its features and are in accordance with local regulations.

articles.title: A Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering Framework with Automated Cluster Cardinality Estimation Ability
articles.summary: Fuzzy clustering provides a robust framework for handling ambiguous and overlapping data boundaries, yet its traditional formulation generates entirely dense membership assignments that limit noise resilience and prevent estimating the true number of clusters, when it is unknown.

articles.title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
articles.summary: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer.

articles.title: GCC 17 Compiler Merges Support For AVX10V1AUX
articles.summary: Landing today into the GCC 17 compiler codebase is initial support for AVX10V1AUX as the auxillary updates to AVX10.1 that are out of the cross-vendor AI Compute Extensions 'ACE' initiative between AMD and Intel.

articles.title: Affinity is coming to Linux (but there’s no ETA yet)
articles.summary: Affinity, the free design suite made by Canva, is coming to Linux. No release date yet, but the company say the port is already in 'active development'.

articles.title: Linux Mint is ‘bringing back’ hibernation to laptops
articles.summary: Linux Mint’s next release will offer a hibernation mode, so you can close your laptop mid-session and not worry about returning to a drained battery.

articles.title: Raspberry Pi announce another eye-watering price hike
articles.summary: Hot off the back of price rises it announced in October , the Raspberry Pi Foundation today said the cost of its Raspberry Pi 5 single-board computers is going up again.
